dataset: NHANES 2013-2018 (H+I+J, 17,032 rows, 3.8% positive) - label KIQ022 = ever told weak/failing kidneys; age / measured BP (BPX) / diabetes (DIQ010) / high-BP history (BPQ020) / nocturia>=2 (KIQ480) are real app columns; ankle-swelling & fatigue are not collected in NHANES (NaN). Replaces the 400-row UCI CKD set whose AUC 0.955 was inflated.
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use
Columns the source dataset never collected: ankle_swelling, ckd_fatigue — the app still asks these but the model cannot use them (LOW_FEATURE_MODEL)
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device
